rationale: With only 3 minutes to market close, there is effectively no time horizon to realize any directional edge — any position opened now would be forced to close almost immediately into end-of-day auction conditions. Price is sitting at 20% of its intraday range, well below the 5-min VWAP of $6.18 and below the 9-EMA, reflecting a prolonged fade from the $7.07 high, but the micro ATR of $0.06 combined with a wide bid-ask spread and an already-negative daily P&L makes the risk/reward unattractive regardless of direction. Time constraint alone is sufficient to disqualify any new entry.
